<ApiTitle method="get" title="Get Document Recipients" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/recipients"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every recipient on a document with their signing status, email history and who sent the document. Use `effectiveStatus` to see who you are still waiting on, because it also reflects a voided or expired document.
